A block marker on a continuation line of multiline alt text is escaped

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<img alt=\"Alpha\n-\nBeta\" src=\"image.png\">", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
